title: Cesarops Forge v2 Local Ping OperatorSpec
architecture_overview: This OperatorSpec defines a 'ping' operation for local P100/RTX coders within the cesarops-forge-v2 environment. It ensures basic system health, network connectivity to critical services, and local GPU availability, while strictly adhering to the T440 LLM port isolation constraint.
constraints: T440 P100 LLM ports (:5001/:5002 on 10.0.0.61) must remain free during satellite runs.
risks: Scripts might require specific environment variables or configurations not explicitly listed, leading to execution failures.
The 'ping' might not cover all potential failure points, leading to a false sense of security.
The cesarops2-isolate-from-t440.sh script might not fully prevent port conflicts if other rogue processes are running.

explicit_steps: Execute /data/codebase/repos/wreckhunter2000-1/scripts/cesarops2-isolate-from-t440.sh to ensure no local services conflict with T440 LLM ports.
Review script output for confirmation of isolation.
ordered_tasks.done_condition: The cesarops2-isolate-from-t440.sh script reports successful isolation and no port conflicts with 10.0.0.61:5001/5002.

explicit_steps: Execute /data/codebase/repos/wreckhunter2000-1/scripts/cesarops-activity-watch.sh --quick-status to get a snapshot of running cesarops-forge-v2 services and network health.
Analyze the output for any critical service failures or network connectivity issues.
ordered_tasks.done_condition: The cesarops-activity-watch.sh script reports all essential cesarops-forge-v2 services are active or reachable, and no critical network errors are present.

explicit_steps: Execute /data/codebase/repos/wreckhunter2000-1/scripts/accelerator_fleet_probe.sh to detect and verify the health of local P100/RTX GPUs.
Confirm that at least one P100 or RTX GPU is detected and reported as healthy.
ordered_tasks.done_condition: The accelerator_fleet_probe.sh script successfully identifies at least one P100 or RTX GPU and reports its operational status as healthy.
